Department.name: Cardiology
Department.description: Comprehensive heart care, cardiovascular surgery, and arrhythmia treatments.

Department.name: Neurology
Department.description: Advanced diagnosis and treatment for brain, spine, and nervous system disorders.

Department.name: Orthopedics
Department.description: Specialized joint replacements, sports injuries, and trauma rehabilitation.

Department.name: Pediatrics
Department.description: Compassionate pediatric care from newborns to adolescents.

Department.name: Dermatology
Department.description: Clinical and cosmetic skin care, laser treatments, and allergy testing.

Department.name: General Medicine
Department.description: Holistic preventive healthcare, lifestyle diseases, and chronic management.

Department.name: Oncology
Department.description: Multi-disciplinary cancer therapy, precision oncology, and supportive care.

Department.name: Gastroenterology
Department.description: Advanced endoscopic procedures, liver health, and digestive wellness.

Department.name: Ophthalmology
Department.description: Complete eye care, cataract surgery, and retinal laser therapies.

Department.name: ENT
Department.description: Ear, nose, throat and micro-laryngeal surgical treatments.
